 Mr. Anand Dilip Landge, Aor
 For Respondent(s)
 Upon
hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1. Delay condoned.

2. Having heard learned senior counsel for the petitioner at a considerable length, we are satisfied that no case to interfere with the impugned judgment dated 09.02.2022 passed by the High Court Sreemitra Estates Pvt. Ltd vs Telangana State Industrial ... on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183586778/
1 for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad, in so far as it upholds the acquisition of the land, is called for.

sentences.text:
17:04:41 IST Reason: Consequently, the special leave petition is dismissed.
However, the petitioner shall be entitled to raise its claim for compensation in accordance with the law.

4. Mr. Dama Seshadri Naidu, learned senior counsel submits that the petitioner is entitled to claim compensation as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

The petitioner, if so advised, may raise such a plea before the appropriate forum.
5.
All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
